parameters.name: AgentId
parameters.description: Optional. By default, the default agent is used. You can also specify an agent that was generated after enabling the DAS Agent service or an agent that you manually created.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: Deprecated parameter. The instance ID is passed through the Query field.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The natural language description for the query.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: Optional. The session ID in UUID string format. If not specified, a new session is created. To maintain context across conversations, use the same session ID.
